column7: Typo – Source Citation: Bhojarāja's Campūrāmāyaṇa (Rām. Ch.), Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa (Stabaka 4), Verse 24. LB Philological Justification: The digitized string contains a demonstrable typographical corruption. By the mandatory application of Pāṇini 8.4.60 (tor li), the external sandhi junction of the upasarga ut and the present active participle lasat mathematically necessitates the complete assimilation of the dental 't' into the lateral 'l', producing ullasat. The digitized rendering udalasad represents an invalid, arrested state of sandhi and must be corrected to ullasad to re-establish absolute Pāṇinian orthographic integrity.
